name: Boneshard Skeleton
subjectPrompt: Ancient upright skeletal warrior. The subject's right arm is missing the HAND and FOREARM PAST THE ELBOW, ending in a jagged visibly shattered bone stump. Its left arm has NO HAND and an old rusted scimitar blade is wired straight onto the left forearm, clearly bound to bone with gray loops. Ancient scraps of brown burial cloth and muted purple necrotic light in each eye socket. Show the entire figure, both arms and their unique endpoints clearly.

name: Ettercap Webspinner
subjectPrompt: A squat purple spider humanoid with mottled violet limbs and pale egg-shaped belly plates matching the pictured Spellgard ettercap. The webspinner holds one long wooden SPEAR with a pointed tip upright in its right grip across the page. Its empty left claw is spinning a small fan of white silk. Both the silk and the entire spear fit safely within the square. One full specimen, not two.
